articles.title: The Physicist and the Broken Fountain
articles.text: A retired physicist visited a temple nursery each week because his love of teaching led him to help children question ordinary objects. When the courtyard fountain failed, the children blamed a tin eagle that had fallen into the basin. He treated their idea as a raw hypothesis, observed the pump's reaction, and found leaves blocking the inlet instead. They learned to dispose of garden waste properly and to see failure as an invitation to test evidence rather than assign blame.
articles.translation: 一位退休物理学家每周到寺庙托儿所，因为他喜欢帮助孩子探索日常物品。庭院喷泉发生故障时，孩子们怪罪掉进水池的一只锡鹰。他把孩子们的想法当作初步假设，观察水泵反应，最终发现真正原因是树叶堵住入口。他们学会妥善处理园林废物，也懂得把故障视为检验证据的机会，而不是急于归咎。

articles.title: How Stone Fountains Circulate Water
articles.text: A fountain sends water upward because a pump gives it pressure, and gravity brings the water back to its basin. Early builders could pack channels with clay; a pioneer might describe the design in a letter, although exact plans were precious and rare. Fine drops dance in the air and form a cool fog, while tender stone edges slowly wear away. The final outcome depends on balanced flow, clean filters, and maintenance that respects both sculpture and machinery.
articles.translation: 喷泉向上喷水，是因为水泵提供压力，而重力又把水带回水池。早期建造者会用黏土填实水道；先驱可能在信中描述设计，但精确图纸珍贵而稀少。细小水滴在空中跳动，形成凉雾，而脆弱的石边会逐渐磨损。最终效果取决于平衡水流、清洁过滤器，以及兼顾雕塑与机械的维护。

articles.title: A Treaty Needs Words People Understand
articles.text: A treaty is not efficient merely because diplomats sign it quickly or because its language sounds formal. People living on either slope of a border must understand the distinction between a legal duty and a voluntary promise. Furthermore, communities should discuss how violations will be investigated; vague rules can punish the weak while powerful actors escape. Citizens may be grateful for peace, but lasting trust requires translations, public meetings, and clear ways to challenge a decision.
articles.translation: 条约并不会仅因外交官迅速签署或语言正式就变得高效。生活在边界两侧山坡的人必须理解法律义务与自愿承诺之间的区别。此外，社区应讨论如何调查违规；模糊规定可能惩罚弱者，却让强势者逃脱。公民会感谢和平，但持久信任还需要译文、公开会议，以及挑战决定的清晰途径。
